title: EmbodiedSWE: Coding Agents for Long Horizon Dexterous Robotics
authors: Zeyu Shen, Haoxiang You, Yilang Liu, Zhicheng Zheng, Lihan Zha, Kashu Yamazaki, Mingtong Zhang, Suning Huang, Jiankai Sun, Qianzhong Chen, Lucy He, Kaiyuan Liu, Haoran Chang, Katerina Fragkiadaki, Dhruv Shah, Mac Schwager, Peter Henderson, Ian Abraham, Canwen Xu

hands.zh: 论文 v2 列五种本体：Franka 两指平行夹爪、xArm7 连杆夹爪或 Panda 夹爪、Kinova Gen3＋Panda 夹爪、双 Franka 平行夹爪、G1 双三指手。真机 VLA 为 Franka＋Robotiq 2F-85；当前项目页宣称支持 17 种本体，不等于论文五种配置之外均已完成同等评测。
hands.en: Paper v2 lists five embodiments: Franka with a two-finger parallel gripper, xArm7 with a linkage or Panda gripper, Kinova Gen3 with a Panda gripper, bimanual Franka with parallel grippers, and G1 with two three-finger hands. Hardware VLA uses Franka with Robotiq 2F-85. The current project advertises 17 embodiments; this does not establish equivalent paper evaluation of all later additions.

tasks.zh: 28 项任务：装配 9、收纳 4、益智 6、形变物／液体 4、切割 2、移动操作 3；单次物理执行可达约半小时。Agent 需提交 solve(env) 程序，主比较每任务给 4 小时开发预算，按独立隐藏评分及成功率、耗时、成本评测；不是 28×全部本体的完整组合。
tasks.en: Twenty-eight tasks cover assembly (9), packing (4), puzzles (6), deformables/liquids (4), cutting (2) and loco-manipulation (3), with physical execution horizons up to about 30 minutes. Agents submit solve(env) programs under a four-hour development budget per task in the main comparison, evaluated through independent hidden grading, success, time and cost. The benchmark is not a full 28-task-by-all-embodiment evaluation matrix.

cross_hand.zh: 六项任务把已验证的 Franka 程序作为提示，迁移到 Kinova Gen3 和 xArm7；三者共用 Panda 夹爪，主要验证跨机械臂代码适配，不是跨手型策略共享。G1 等其他末端有任务支持，但未报告同一策略在所有手型上的配对零样本验证。
cross_hand.en: On six tasks, verified Franka programs serve as hints for Kinova Gen3 and xArm7. All three carry the Panda gripper, testing cross-arm program adaptation rather than cross-hand policy sharing. Other effectors such as G1 hands have task support, but matched zero-shot shared-policy validation across all hand morphologies is not reported.

release.zh: 官方 GitHub 已公开基准、Agent 评测、EmbodiedSWE-Gen 与 VLA 训练／评测代码，Hugging Face 已公开任务和场景仿真资产；支持基于 Isaac Lab 的运行，形变物套件使用 Newton。完整生成示范集及训练好的 VLA／Agent checkpoint 下载尚未核实；资产包不等于示范数据集。
release.en: Official GitHub releases the benchmark, agent evaluation, EmbodiedSWE-Gen and VLA training/evaluation code; Hugging Face provides task and scene simulation assets. Execution is based on Isaac Lab, with Newton for the deformable suite. Downloads of complete generated demonstration datasets and trained VLA/agent checkpoints remain unverified; the asset collection is not a demonstration dataset.

highlight.zh: EmbodiedSWE 构建包含 28 项长时序机器人操作任务的仿真基准，评测 Coding Agent 编程求解及跨任务、跨本体迁移能力，并将成功程序扩增为示范数据训练 VLA；以独立评分和回放检查连接“程序求解评测→可验证训练数据”。
highlight.en: EmbodiedSWE benchmarks coding-agent program synthesis and cross-task/cross-embodiment transfer on 28 long-horizon simulated robotics tasks, then expands successful programs into VLA demonstrations, linking program-solving evaluation to verified training data through independent grading and replay checks.

evaluation_scope.zh: 求解 Agent 可读取完整仿真状态并调试程序，使用通用 IK／操作空间等控制器；独立评分环境禁用物体状态写入，不能把特权状态求解成绩当作纯视觉策略成绩。Gen 从成功解扩增场景、策略、中间阶段、动力学和视觉，筛选成功且可回放的轨迹。仿真 SmolVLA 实验限六项子任务，输入多视角 RGB、指令及 8 维关节／夹爪状态，输出关节目标；部分任务放宽了原始基准成功条件，不能与完整 28 项 Agent 成绩直接比较。真机用 500 条仿真示范微调 π₀.₅-DROID 拆台灯，无真机示范参与微调；十次试验最终旋出并取下灯泡为 20%，checkpoint 按真机表现选择。另有合成 400 个环境对 Coding Agent 做 PPO 后训练，未完成未见任务评测；该 RL 不等于主线 VLA 动作策略训练。
evaluation_scope.en: Solver agents inspect full simulator state and debug programs using generic IK/operational-space controllers; independent graders disable object-state writes. Privileged-state solver results are not vision-only policy results. Gen diversifies scenes, strategies, intermediate phases, dynamics and appearance, retaining successful replay-verified trajectories. Simulated SmolVLA experiments cover only six tasks, taking multi-view RGB, instructions and 8-D joint/gripper state to joint targets. Some success criteria are relaxed relative to the original benchmark, precluding direct comparison with full 28-task agent results. Hardware lamp disassembly finetunes π₀.₅-DROID on 500 simulation demonstrations without real demonstrations for finetuning; final bulb unscrewing/extraction succeeds in 20% of ten trials, with checkpoint selection based on hardware performance. A separate study PPO-post-trains a coding agent on 400 generated environments without completed held-out evaluation; this RL is not the main VLA action-learning procedure.
